project_info.theme: End season polo promotion with product board and price callout

main_subject.detail: A clean commercial composite featuring a young Asian male model on the left wearing a fitted white polo shirt with thin black tipping on the collar and sleeves, paired with black trousers, alongside a vertical product board on the right showing folded polos in multiple colors and a large blue price callout of 149K.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic fashion sale poster, ecommerce apparel graphic, polished retail advertising

items: Left: front-facing young Asian male model cropped from mid-thigh upward, standing with one hand in pocket, wearing a white polo with black tipping and black pants against a pale gray interior backdrop with vertical blinds.
Top Right: black wordmark 'BADASS' on a white field.
Right Center: inset product photo card showing folded polos in black, white, navy, gray, and dark teal stacked diagonally on a beige sofa.
Lower Right: oversized blue numeric price '149K' on a white geometric panel that crops off the bottom-right corner.
Lower Left: yellow banner with blue drop shadow reading 'END SEASON SALE'.
Near product card bottom: small black product code 'POHTK602'.
Frame accents: thin bright yellow strip at the top edge and light blue color block entering from the bottom edge.

prompt_instructions: Attach the original image to preserve the exact collage composition and model identity.
Keep all visible text exactly as shown, including 'BADASS', 'POHTK602', 'END SEASON SALE', and '149K'.
Maintain the left-model-right-product-board balance and the cropped oversized price panel.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square BADASS fashion sale poster for an end-season polo promotion. Place a photorealistic young Asian male model on the left, cropped from mid-thigh upward, wearing a fitted white polo with thin black tipping on the collar and sleeve cuffs and black trousers, standing against a pale gray interior with vertical blinds. On the right, create a tall white product board with the black wordmark 'BADASS' at the top, a product inset photo showing folded polos in black, white, navy, gray, and dark teal on a beige sofa, and the small code 'POHTK602' below the product image. Add a yellow banner with blue shadow reading 'END SEASON SALE' near the lower left and a huge blue '149K' price on a white geometric block cropping off the bottom-right edge. Use a thin yellow top strip and a light blue lower accent. Technical style: photorealistic fashion ecommerce poster with magazine-style collage layout, soft studio-commercial lighting, clean retail atmosphere, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
